high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "facts._hub." The post is titled "Technology after death in Japan" and features two photographs of QR codes on gravestones. Photographs: The left photograph shows a gravestone with a QR code engraved on it. The background appears to be a cemetery with other gravestones and greenery. The right photograph shows a person holding a smartphone, scanning another QR code on a gravestone. The gravestone has some text written in Chinese characters, which translates to "Nanjing Massacre victims."
